units.summary: Adds a benchmark of Head.filterSeriesAndSortPostings at several input fractions. It runs only under go test -bench and does not touch production code.
units.headline: New benchmark for filterSeriesAndSortPostings at varying selectivity
units.reason: New benchmark-only code that cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook variable that compactHeadViewLocked calls before eviction. It is nil in production, so it has no effect unless a test sets it.
units.headline: Add testing callback hook invoked before head eviction
units.reason: Unexported hook that is nil unless a test sets it; the call site is reviewed in compactHeadViewLocked.

units.summary: Extracts the block-write, reload and evict loop shared by CompactStaleHead and CompactSelectedSeries. It adds an appendID watermark captured before writing, a loop bound that is now inclusive (mint <= maxt), skipping empty writes, and a pre-evict test hook. These change which series are evicted and which blocks are written, so a reviewer must judge them.
units.headline: Shared head-view compaction helper with append-ID watermark and inclusive range
units.reason: Persistence and eviction logic with concurrency-sensitive watermark; data loss is possible if wrong.
focus: maxt is read before the watermark is captured; check that a sample committed between the two reads, with a timestamp past the last written chunk range, is still protected by the evictor's maxt check
The empty-uids continue skips reloadBlocks; check that no state is left inconsistent
The package-global test callback is cleared after use and is not safe if compactions run concurrently
The inclusive loop bound writes an extra slice when maxt falls exactly on a chunk boundary

units.summary: Renames staleIndex to selectedSeriesIndex and changes its argument and return types to the renamed types. The logic is unchanged.
units.headline: Rename staleIndex to selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Pure rename of an unexported method and types, with the caller (SelectedSeriesHead.Index) updated; the body is identical.

units.summary: Renames headStaleIndexReader to headSelectedSeriesIndexReader, renames its field, and rewrites the doc comment. The struct layout is otherwise the same and the type is unexported.
units.headline: Rename headStaleIndexReader to headSelectedSeriesIndexReader
units.reason: Rename of an unexported type and field with all uses updated in the PR; no logic change.

units.summary: Renames the unexported staleSeriesRefs struct to seriesRefs. The fields are unchanged.
units.headline: Rename staleSeriesRefs to seriesRefs
units.reason: Pure rename of an unexported struct with identical fields and all uses updated in the PR.

units.summary: Generalizes the stale-series lookup into a function that takes arbitrary postings and a keep predicate run under the series lock. Series are returned sorted by ref order and by labels. The stale and OOO logic moves into predicates, and the debug log text changes.
units.headline: Generalize stale series filtering to postings plus keep predicate
units.reason: Core series selection for compaction and eviction; the predicate and locking semantics determine which series are evicted.
focus: The predicate runs under s.Lock; check that no predicate takes other locks
sortedByRef follows the input order, so callers must pass ref-sorted postings (CompactSelectedSeries sorts and dedups)
When keep is nil, the series fields are not read under the lock; check that no caller passes nil

units.summary: Reimplements staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData as a call to filterSeriesAndSortPostings with a predicate of no OOO data and stale. The predicate matches the removed inline logic.
units.headline: staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData delegates to shared filter function
units.reason: Refactor with the same predicate (ooo == nil and stale NaN checks) as the removed inline code.
